name: 吃苹果吗-生成验证
look: High-detail photorealistic 3D CGI, soft natural indoor light.
setting: The two characters stand facing each other.
constraints: 角色2全程持有苹果。角色1不接苹果、不吃苹果。没有和解，不添加其他角色。
source_script:
角色2动作：双手拿着洗好的红苹果，递向角色1。
角色2：吃苹果吗？
角色1：不吃。
角色2动作：仍然拿着苹果，向角色1靠近半步。
角色2：多吃苹果对身体好。
角色1：我不想吃。
角色2：都洗好了，别浪费，就吃一口吧。
角色1动作：不接苹果，抬起一只手拒绝，身体稍微转开。
角色1：不吃不吃，我真不想吃。
角色2动作：将苹果收回胸前，空着的手指向角色1，语气生气。
角色2：不吃就不吃，发什么脾气？你这个性格怎么跟人相处？

events.text: 双手拿着洗好的红苹果，递向角色1。
仍然拿着苹果，向角色1靠近半步。
都洗好了，别浪费，就吃一口吧。
不接苹果，抬起一只手拒绝，身体稍微转开。
将苹果收回胸前，空着的手指向角色1，语气生气。
不吃就不吃，发什么脾气？你这个性格怎么跟人相处？

execution.look: High-detail photorealistic 3D CGI, soft natural indoor light.
execution.setting: The two characters stand facing each other.

directions.event_001: Character 2 retains the single washed red apple in both hands while extending it toward Character 1.
directions.event_004: Character 2 still holds the apple and moves half a step closer to Character 1.
directions.event_008: Character 1 keeps both hands visibly empty, raises one empty open palm in refusal, and turns slightly away. Character 2 retains the single apple.
directions.event_010: Character 2 draws the apple back to her chest, keeps holding it in one hand, and points at Character 1 with her free hand, angrily.

execution.visible_state: Only Character 2 holds the single red apple throughout. Character 1 keeps both hands visibly empty. Their exchange remains unresolved, with only the two declared characters visible.
